about: 50 test orders for Halcyon, built from the seeded database (npm run db:tables): real client IDs, product IDs, SKUs and the stock at each warehouse on 30 October 2026. 24 API orders and 26 emails covering clear and unclear products, full and half addresses, quantities, the 08:00 cutoff, stock at the nearest warehouse, farther away or nowhere, repeats, blank emails, emails with no order, and bad input.
setup: API orders: sign in as a client user of the order's clientId, then POST request.body to /api/order-requests. Create the logins first (Clients → the client → add a user) with the emails in signInAs.

Emails: insert each email object as an inbound email (the shape EmailRepository.insert takes, mailbox 'orders@halcyon.test'). For a client match, the client login must exist with the sender's address (orders@client001.example, orders@client003.example, orders@client054.example).
The 'not an order' and quantity-in-words cases need the email agent (FOUNDRY_*) configured.
Stock figures are available units (on hand minus reserved). Nearest warehouse by region: Northeast W4, Midwest W1 (W2 is 50 miles farther), Southeast W3, West W5.
Cutoff 08:00 America/New_York. On 2 Nov 2026 New York is on EST (UTC-5), so 12:20Z is 07:20 ET (before) and 13:00Z is 08:00 ET (at the cutoff, so next day).
